title: Timer auto-complete & Health Connect writes
highlights: New Device setting: Complete exercise when set timer stops. When on, stopping or closing a set timer (rounds, warm-up, or cool-down) marks that exercise done and fills Did with time elapsed. Reset never completes on its own.

New Health Connect setting: Save finished workouts to Health Connect. If you decline write access once, we turn this off so you are not prompted after every workout. Turn it back on anytime under Settings → Device.

title: Log several foods in a row
highlights: When logging a meal item, use Add Another to save and jump straight back to search or barcode scan for the same meal-no need to reopen the sheet.
Tap Log when you're done to save and close.

title: Swap across categories
highlights: Swapping an exercise now works like adding one: category pills let you browse the full training library, starting on the prescribed category.
Pick All or another category when you want a different movement for that slot. Stretch swaps stay warm-up / cool-down only.
